title: Priced By rows inside a category follow Sales by Tier's order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, in category A, cost $10.00, fixed sell price $12.50.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A and a part in category A with a typed price of $80.00, invoiced today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, with that fixed-price part and a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $135.00 by Default, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Pick customers A and B in the Customer filter.
  3. Open category A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 2:

  • Category A reads $349.00 ($121.50 + $80.00 + $12.50 + $135.00).

Step 3:

  • Rows read Default, tier A, Fixed price, Manual, in that order.
